guidetextdraw._value: REQUEST TO CANCEL FINANCIAL AID PROCESSING (2021-2022)
guidetextdraw.name: headingText

panel_564360763.jcr:title: Form Section
panel_564360763.name: formContainer

guidetextdraw_copy_c.text: Federal law requires a recipient of financial aid to be either a United States citizen or an eligible non-citizen. In order to verify your status as eligible for federal aid, complete this form and attach the required documents. Incomplete documents will not be returned. They will be disposed of in a secure manner, per university policy. This will delay processing.

guidetextdraw_208076._value:
INSTRUCTIONS:  

Use this form to request full cancellation of your financial aid application for the 2021-2022 academic year. To revise your aid award to one semester complete the Award Adjustment Appeal Form.
guidetextdraw_208076.name: textdraw_208076511659356871869

guidetextdraw_137310._value: I will not attend Cal State Fullerton during the 2021-2022 academic year.  Please cancel my financial aid application and, if funds have been awarded to me, please cancel all awards.
